If you're like me, you want Voat to be and stay a place where relevant content is easily seen.

If you don't like to see those annoying pictures and gifs taking the place of solid news and important information on the front page, then you can simply block the subverses those posts came from!

Here's how it's done:

  1. Find a subverse you don't want to see on the front page (I personally recommend starting with /v/funny and /v/gifs)

  2. Go to that subverses page.

  3. Click on the little "Block" Button next to the "Subscribe" button

  4. Enjoy your noise free front page! :)

What does this do:

  • Gets rid of the noise from the front page and /v/all

What this does NOT do:

  • Stops you from viewing that subverse. Even if you block a subverse you can still go to it and view the content (for the times when you want to see that sub's content)

There's nothing wrong with people posting funny pictures; however, in my opinion, I prefer it not to take the place of important news. I would rather my front page stay a noise free zone :)
